name: JALI 22 Viseme
description: Connect the 22 JALI lip-sync attributes by the same name, Source -> Destination: Jaw and Lip (the JA-LI control axes) plus the 20 visemes (Ah Aa Eh Ee Ih Oh Uh U Eu Schwa R S ShChZh Th JY LNTD GK MBP FV W). Objects are paired row by row (Source[i] -> Destination[i]); an attribute missing on either side is skipped.
